title: ForgeAccountUpdatedPayload

forgeAccountId.description: A forge account's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

slug.description: The new slug, when it changed.

aliases.description: The aliases now, when they changed.

origin.description: A forge origin: https, or http for a LAN or tailnet instance, then the host in lower case and a port only when it is not the scheme's default (https://git.example.com:5526); no userinfo, path or trailing slash.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

verifiedAt.description: When the credential last answered as the forge account's identity on this origin; null while unverified, when it is not served.

items.description: A second origin the same forge instance answers on, and when the forge account's identity was last verified there.

credential.description: The new credential source, when the credential was replaced.

oneOf.description: The environment's own gh, signed in for the forge account's host and login, read on every operation so it follows gh's rotations.

provenance.description: Where a stored token came from: pasted (a person pasted it), client-gh (the attending client handed over its own gh's token once, which does not follow gh's rotations), imported (the state import carried it over) or oauth (a device flow, milestone 3).

entry.description: The environment's vault entry holding a stored token, one per credential it was given: forge:<forge account id>:<entry id>. Never the token itself.

oneOf.description: A token the environment holds in its vault, never answered again: where it came from, and the vault entry that holds it.
A key-manager reference, resolved per operation and never cached; its connection and locator arrive with the key-manager references.
No credential: a copy from another environment awaiting one here.

identity.description: Who a new credential answered as, when it answered: the same user id, its login as it is now.

login.description: The login the forge's user endpoint answered, which may change while the user id stays.

userId.description: The forge's numeric user id as decimal digits, a string so that no JSON reader rounds it: what makes a credential the same identity.

problem.description: The problem after a new credential, when the credential was replaced: null when it answered.

kind.description: What is wrong with a forge account: needs-credential (a copy with none), credential-rejected (401 on its identity), credential-unavailable (the key manager or gh signed out, or the vault entry missing), identity-changed (another user id answered; unused until the credential is replaced), unreachable (the forge did not answer) or expiring (the token expires within thirty days).

since.description: Since when the forge account has had this problem.

message.description: One line for people: what is wrong and what to do.

anyOf.description: A forge account's problem: which, since when, and one line saying what to do.

description: forge.account.updated: a forge account's slug, aliases or credential changed; each field present only when it did.
